CustomField.formula: IF( HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24))) = 0, "12", IF( HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24))) > 12, TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24))) - 12), TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24)))) ) ) & ":" & IF( MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24))) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24)))), TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24)))) ) & " " & IF( HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate + (10/24))) < 12, "AM", "PM" )
CustomField.label: Created Time
